content: Ben-Gay, more recently spelled as Bengay, is a topical analgesic heat rub designed to alleviate muscle and joint pain. This product was originally developed in France by Dr. Jules Bengué and was introduced to the United States in 1898. Initially, it was manufactured by Pfizer Consumer Healthcare, which was later acquired by Johnson & Johnson. Active Ingredients The active ingredients in Bengay vary depending on the specific formulation of the product: Bengay Original contains 15% methyl salicylate and 10% menthol. Bengay Muscle Pain/Ultra Strength contains 30% methyl salicylate, 10% menthol, and 4% camphor. Bengay Ice Extra Strength contains 10% menthol. Bengay Muscle Pain/No Odor contains 15% triethanolamine salicylate. Bengay Arthritis Extra Strength contains 30% methyl salicylate and 8% menthol. It is important to highlight that methyl salicylate, one of the active ingredients, can be toxic if the cream is overused or applied in excessive amounts.
